nina: FYI scheduled change window tonight 22:30 UTC. Router v3.5.0 + runtime v4.0.1. Need a short pin on router while we validate runtime KV tweak.
carlos: Runtime 4.0.1 includes kv-header canonicalization fix. Should be safe but may change routing hashes for sticky sessions.
kevin: Any migration? If sticky hashes change users could see session stickiness move. How long will pin be?
nina: Pin plan: router pinned to 3.5.0 for 2h post-deploy, canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. If stable after 2h we'll unpin.
dana: Ops: define rollback triggers. Propose: sustained p99 increase >150ms, 5xx spike >0.4% for 2m, or user-reported session-reshuffle >0.5% from smoke.
deploy-bot: schedule set by @nina at 2026-04-02T22:30:00Z
ops-bot: Quiet window auto-lock 22:15-23:15 UTC. Alert hooks enabled.
carlos: Staging run logs (short): ```WARN routing: session-hash-change detected for 0.12% of flows
INFO kv: canonicalized header x-kv-id```
kevin: Exclude Dedicated eu cluster — they have pinned kernels that don't like runtime 4.0.1 quant path. We'll route around them.
dana: Good catch. Add dedicated/exclude policy: `route: exclude=dedicated-eu` during canary.
nina: Commands for oncall:
```
# pin router
deploy-bot pin service=router version=3.5.0 --until=+2h --by=@nina
# start canary
deploy-bot route service=router percent=5 monitor=5m
# emergency rollback
deploy-bot rollback service=router to-version=3.4.9 --reason="runtime-compat-fail" --immediate
```
kevin: I'll prep a tiny traffic probe that checks session affinity and a KV header histogram.
dana: Watchlist: router/p99, router/5xx, sessions/reshuffle_rate, runtime/kv_mismatch, dedicated/compat_alarms. Set pager if any breach.
deploy-bot: Canary 5% initiated by @nina at 2026-04-02T22:30:00Z
ops-bot: Dashboards: https://grafana.internal/d/rtr/canary-1779999991 and https://grafana.internal/d/rtm/runtime-1779999991
carlos: 5m smoke: session reshuffle 0.08%, p99 +12ms. good to move to 25%.
kevin: Dedicated exclusion working. No kernel errors in logs.
dana: Moving to 25% now. Holding 10m.
nina: If we see user affinity regressions >0.3% at 25% hold, we rollback and remove pin.
carlos: 25% hold passed. Proceeding to full.
deploy-bot: 100% shift executed by @nina at 2026-04-02T22:55:00Z
kevin: Final quick smoke green. Removing pin scheduled at 2026-04-03T00:55:00Z unless issues.
dana: Filing short release note: https://docs.internal/releases/2026-04-02-router-runtime-compat - include dedicated exclusion and rollback criteria.
nina: Thanks all. Postmortem if any issues. :rocket:
